# kvlang

> A plaintext, interpreted language where code and data live in one KV tree.
> The program counter is a path, the source is the IR, every value is plaintext.

## Canonical sources

- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/array2d/kvlang/master/README.md)
- [README (Chinese)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/array2d/kvlang/master/README_CN.md)
- [Specification](https://github.com/array2d/kvlang/tree/master/stdlib/kvlang/spec)
- [Tutorials](https://github.com/array2d/kvlang/tree/master/tutorial)
- [Standard library documents](https://kvlang.com/stdlib/)
- [Install script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/array2d/kvlang/master/install.sh)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/array2d/kvlang)

## Notes

- This homepage is static HTML; all facts are traceable to the spec or the tutorial.
- The stdlib page is client-rendered. Crawlers that do not execute JS should use the
  raw sources above (the GitHub trees API or raw.githubusercontent.com).
